title: TransAgents: Build Your Translation Company with Language Agents

live_model.evidence: Sec. 4.1: 'the backbone of the language agents in TRANSAGENTS is GPT-4-TURBO. We compare TRANSAGENTS with NLLB-200-3.3B, GOOGLETRANS, GPT-4-TURBO, and GPT-4O.' footnote 2: 'gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09'

prompt.location: Baseline translation prompt not printed; agent role prompts only described

data.source: Literary set from Wang et al. (2023b) (240 web-novel chapters, public); legal and financial sets are in-house

notes: Winning-rate results (Table 2) rely on human preference; d-BLEU on the literary set is automatic but the baseline prompt and chunking are unspecified. Chapters average 1,400 words, so calls are long.
